title: Capital spending nearly tripled in two years; 2026 guidance is hatched
subtitle: Four years of actuals summed from quarterly SEC filings, and a 2026 range from company guidance. The flat 2023 is real.
caption: Every dollar of this eventually needs technicians in an aisle. The 2025 figure is the five-company total; most published 'hyperscaler capex' numbers cover four companies and come in near $390B, which is why the memo's number can look high. Watney's funding is deliberately not on this axis.
source: Epoch AI, hyperscaler capex trend, updated February 27, 2026, from XBRL filings. 2026 guidance per Introl, February 20, 2026.
